newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA GAINS AS KIRCH RIVAL BOWS OUT - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA GAINS AS KIRCH RIVAL BOWS OUT - PAPER.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy's position in the multimedia terminal market could strengthen after Bertelsmann announced its withdrawal from the German digital TV business, daily Kauppalehti said on Tuesday.
Bertelsmann, a German media group, is a tough competitor of another German media group, Kirch, which last year ordered one million multimedia terminals from Nokia, Kauppalehti said.

"Nokia sees the potential of these markets as very interesting. But at this stage it is still very difficult to make any final estimates," it quoted Nokia head of information Seppo Harkonen as saying.
Bertelsmann last week announced it would withdraw from the German digital TV business for the time being due to bleak market prospects, Kauppalehti said.
Kirch's prospects in the digital TV business are not regarded as very good either, the paper said, and experts expect the group to run up losses of 1.1 billion German marks from the business by 2000.
